findings.text: the closing caveat says the documentation axis's accept rate is computed only over the 143 items that did decide, but docs/evidence/fragments/sn-review-through-jev/srtj-cohort-run.py:128-130 computes it as accepts / eligible and that is what the same fragment's check table reports - 0.566210 = 124/219, not 124/143 = 0.867 - so the fragment contradicts its own record and misdescribes the number the reader is asked to rely on.

the agreement note claims an item the incumbent leaves unjudged is counted separately rather than folded into a cell, but the incumbent pieces on the branch hold only 115 of the 231 name items and 164 of the 219 docs items and docs/evidence/fragments/sn-review-through-jev/srtj-cohort-run.py:962 keeps only ids present in the incumbent mapping, so the 116 name and 55 docs items with no incumbent row at all fall out of the table that is presented as the route comparison - the name agreement rate is reported over half the cohort without saying so.

wilson_interval re-implements the wilson() helper the repository already carries at docs/evidence/fragments/sn-review-through-jev/srtj-jev-vs-panel-operating-point-run.py:51 - same z, same divisor, same centre and half-width - without importing or extending it, so a third copy of the interval now exists across the fragments and a correction to one will not reach the others.

this figure is outside the node's declared write paths - the five paths at /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/runs/r-20261021T040906172109-srtj-jev-only-dry-run/manifest.md:3 - so a file the node was not fenced to write landed in the diff; the plotting mandate requires a figure in an evidence document, but the scope was never extended to hold it.

the tests: line is prose ('no repository test suite was run on this node; the node's gate is the run itself') rather than the literal command a shell was handed, so promotion's gate receipt has nothing re-runnable to fill from it, and the two axis commands survive only inside the runner's own logs.

the name piece records code_revision 47531e18eb, but that revision carries no --label option, so it cannot have written a piece named cascade-name-jev-only.json; the run used the uncommitted working tree and the recorded revision names the base rather than the code that produced the piece (created_at 04:28:26Z, before c607f163b at 04:29:37Z).
